clips.start_words: I just got a phone call
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a young copywriter texted him out of nowhere: 'I watched every one of your infomercials. I transcribed them word for word. I learned how to sell by copying exactly what you did.'

That copywriter is now regarded as one of the best in the world - and Kevin Trudeau says his own success is now beyond his wildest dreams.

Kevin Trudeau's point: most people try to reinvent the wheel. Duplicate success. Follow the patterns that already work. Success can be copied.

What is one proven pattern you have been avoiding because you wanted to do it your own way?

#kevintrudeau #marketing #successmindset #copywriting #entrepreneur #businesslessons
clips.send: A broke freelance copywriter sends it to another broke freelancer: hope - the best in the world got there by copying, not inventing.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a caller on his show told him he had ADD and was flunking calculus - a straight F because he could not remember the equations.

He had just gone through Kevin Trudeau's memory course, which teaches how to lock an equation into memory in 30 seconds. He studied for half an hour the night before his test.

He scored 100%. His teacher refused to accept it - she assumed he cheated. So he had to retake the exam in the principal's office.

He scored 100% again. I can't forget these equations even if I tried, he said.

Have you ever been punished for doing too well?

#kevintrudeau #memory #studytips #successmindset #megamemory #mindset
clips.send: A struggling student sends it to a friend who thinks they're just bad at tests: hope - once it's learned right, you can't un-learn it.
